caption: Figure 2: LLM architecture, execution workflows, and tuning challenges: (a) Decoder-only Transformer stack with QKV attention and optional MoE in the feed-forward layers. (b) Training (forward, backward, update) and inference (prefill, decode with KV cache) workflows alongside key parallelism schemes. (c) Iterative profiling-based tuning loop and its GPU-hour/design-space explosion on large GPU clusters.
title: Charon: A Unified and Fine-Grained Simulator for Large-Scale LLM Training and Inference
authors: Mengtian Yang, Zhekun Zhang, Mingheng Wu, Jianwen Yan, Hanshi Sun, Li-Wen Chang
